name: art-ecommerce-backend-zero-deps
description: Zero-dependency production-ready TypeScript backend API layer relying exclusively on Node.js 18+ native fetch and node:crypto

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_execpath && !process.env.npm_execpath.includes('pnpm')) { console.error('ERROR: Use pnpm instead of npm/yarn for security (supply-chain protection).'); process.exit(1); }"
